title: Reverse words, keep palindromes
prompt:
Write `ReverseWords(s string) string`. Reverse each space-separated word, but leave words that are palindromes (case-insensitive) unchanged. Keep the spacing exactly as it was.

`"Hello worlD ollo"` → `"olleH Dlrow ollo"`, `"привет мир Ара"` → `"тевирп рим Ара"`
hint: `strings.Split(s, " ")` keeps empty words, so repeated spaces survive; `strings.Fields` doesn't.
